business_problem: BeSmart Campus needed a way to deliver individualized instruction at scale after demand for tutoring surged, but static online video could not answer questions or adapt explanations to each student's pace and understanding.
solution_summary: BeSmart Campus built an interactive learning platform on Google Cloud so educational video content can be paired with real-time AI tutoring instead of passive playback. The company uses Gemini models to analyze and organize teacher-created video lessons, then relies on multimodal understanding to let students pause a lesson at any moment, ask a question about the exact point on screen, and receive an explanation that follows BeSmart's own pedagogical method. Vertex AI and Gemini supply the reasoning layer, while BigQuery supports the data foundation behind the platform's evolving content and results. The system also generates practice exercises on the fly and uses the same course context to explain mistakes, rephrase concepts repeatedly, and guide students through alternative examples. This architecture turns the platform into a personalized tutor that can keep pace with each learner while staying inside a controlled instructional environment.

solution_components.role: Hosts the AI capabilities used to power contextual tutoring across BeSmart's learning platform.

solution_components.name: Gemini Models
solution_components.role: Interpret video context and generate explanations, rephrasings, and practice exercises for students.

solution_components.name: BigQuery
solution_components.role: Supports the platform's data layer for educational content and outcome analysis.

solution_components.name: NotebookLM
solution_components.role: Helped validate that Gemini could understand educational content with the needed contextual fidelity.

data_flow: Teacher-created videos are analyzed and organized with Gemini, students watch those lessons in the BeSmart platform, pause them to ask context-specific questions, and receive grounded responses or generated exercises that stay tied to the exact lesson segment and teaching method.
business_outcome: BeSmart launched its first operational platform in three months, produced measurable student gains in school tests, and created a scalable tutoring model that can re-explain concepts as many times as each learner needs.
metrics: The first operational version of the BeSmart Learning Platform was designed in only three months
two classes allowed to use the platform for two weeks preceding exams achieved averages of 6.4 and 6.9 out of 10
two other classes of the same level, prepared without the platform, showed an average of 5.0
